text: Jon-Jon Jellyneck is a jungle troll located in Crushblow. He is the chieftain of an unnamed tribe, which was recruited by Lady Cozwynn for use of their wyverns against the Twilight's Hammer. He lives in a hut in a beach with a lady.

John Polidora is a Blizzard Entertainment employee, working as an illustrator and concept artist for all of Blizzard's licenses. He creates art for box covers, key art, magazine covers, book covers and interior illustrations, comic book covers, concept and production artwork, posters, and packaging art. His concept art includes textures and models for characters, creatures, weapons, and armor for the World of Warcraft expansions The Burning Crusade and Wrath of the Lich King. He has also produced art for the TCG and Hearthstone, and what appears to be scenery concept art for the Cataclysm expansion.

Jonathan LeCraft is a former Blizzard employee and Senior Game Designer for World of Warcraft. In a article published on August 11, 2021, the gaming website cited internal sources that claimed LeCraft -- along with Luis Barriga and Jesse McCree -- were let go from Blizzard Entertainment. This was later confirmed the same day by a spokesperson for Activision Blizzard, stating that they "are no longer with the company".

Aram later found Jonas in the captain's deck as well as speaking with a cowled man in Flayers' Point. Aram told about these to his father who immediately understood that Jonas has betrayed them. Jorak is a Zandalari troll exile first encountered at the Withering Gulch in Vol'dun. He was exiled to the desert for an unspecified crime and was part of the same group of outcasts as Warguard Rakera, who saved his life from Grozztok the Blackheart when General Jakra'zet's assassins attacked the caravan. After being encountered by Bladeguard Kaja, an adventurer, and Meerah, Jorak accompanies Meerah's Caravan to the Temple of Akunda in the south, where Rakera is believed to have made her way. He gives the last of his belongings to the adventurer so that they can gain entry into the temple and search for Rakera. Jo'nok, Bulwark of Torcali is a Zandalari dire troll located in Zanchul in Dazar'alor. He attended the funeral of King Rastakhan in Dazar'alor. Later, he became a member of Talanji's Zanchuli Council. He is a follower and champion of the loa Torcali. At one point, the loa sent Jo'nok to help the distressed trolls at Antul'Mita Plateau. He and the Speaker discovered heretics and the Bulwark commanded the adventurer to drive the invaders from Zuldazar to Nazmir. After the Fourth War, Jo'nok was present at the wedding of Khila and Nav'rae. When the Horde Council ambassador Zekhan arrived to the scene, Jo'nok offered to smash him, but was stopped by Queen Talanji.

The original pages are no longer available, but most of them can still be viewed through online archives (see below).

Journeyman Maddox was one of the members of Darren's party who went to Uldaman. He was the youngest journeyman in the group. Jousting is a form of combat introduced with the Argent Tournament, using the vehicle game mechanics. At the time of its introduction, jousting was the vehicle used the most in World of Warcraft. Opinions range from hating it because of the difficulty, to loving it because it is a challenging event, and because gear and class do not make a difference; only skill makes a difference in jousting.
Julian Morris is a Forsaken located in the docked ship at Vengeance Landing along with his family Jason, Nicole, and Jessica.
Journeyman Cook is an achievement that requires the character to obtain 150 skill points in the "Classic" category of cooking.
Jotunheim Rapid-Fire Harpoons are harpoon guns found on the ledge of a building in Jotunheim, Icecrown. They were present during Death Rising.
Journeyman Medic is a legacy achievement, originally earned by obtaining 150 skill points in first aid.
Journeyman Fisherman is an achievement that requires the character to obtain 150 skill points in the "Classic" category fishing.
The Jouster was a quest reward from Egg Wave during the Cataclysm beta.

Judgements of the Bold is one of the passive specialization bonuses gained by a paladin when specializing into the Retribution-tree at level 10. It serves as the primary means for a DPS-paladin to generate mana during combat.
Joseph's Hunting Blade drops from The Lone Hunter in the Eastern Plaguelands. It is also provided as an objective for the following quests: *A Strange Historian *Uncle Carlin

Joy Ride is a horde-only quest achievement that requires the player to ride non-stop from one end of the Rocketway in Azshara to the other. Starting at the Northern Rocketway Terminus and riding it all the way to the Southern Rocketway Terminus, or vice versa, will earn this achievement. This is only available to Horde players, as the Bilgewater Rocket-jockeys at each Rocketway station are Horde-flagged.
Juju Brawn is a buff which may be applied to the slayer of a Frostmaul Tumbler in Winterspring. It lasts for 10 minutes and increases health by 400.
Journeyman Archaeologist is an achievement that requires the character to obtain 150 skill points in archaeology.

Jr. Bombardier Hackel is a goblin quest giver found in Azshara. He makes his initial appearance near Bombardier Captain Smooks at the Southern Rocketway Terminus, but he later appears in the vicinity of Valormok, where he gives one quest.
__NOTOC__ Julak-Doom is a rare elite mob in the Twilight Highlands. It is a merciless one controlling a flesh giant of the same name.
Jugger Not is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning the Battle for Gilneas by 100 points or less.
Judkins' Staff is a quest reward from Counter-Plague Research.
Jr. Chef Kracket is a Bilgewater Cartel goblin drink vendor located in the Krazzworks in the Twilight Highlands.
Jr. Archaeologist Ferd is a dwarf quest giver located at the Remtravel's Excavation in Darkshore.

__NOTOC__ Juice Gnugat is a goblin quest giver found on a beached boat upon the Twilight Shores in the Twilight Highlands. He seems particularly unconcerned about dismantling the boat he and Rok'tar are both standing on. He is also encountered at the Remains of the Fleet, though he serves no role there.
Judgments of the Pure is a paladin PvP talent, available at level 20 for Holy specialization or at level 23 for Protection and Retribution.
__NOTOC__ Journeyman Chu is a pandaren located at the Silken Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Joseph Henderson is a Forsaken trade goods vendor located at Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands.

Julia Stevens is an aspiring human Pet Tamer located at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest. Her two level 2 battle pets are at her side: Slither and Fangs. She can be found beside a shed on the north-most part of the Maclure Vineyards. Defeating her is required to complete the Taming Eastern Kingdoms achievement.
Julia Scrabblewrench is a goblin located in the Slick in Bilgewater Port along with five cats - Rima, Avarua, Atiu, Mata and Funafuti.

Joscon is an MVP on the official EU Spanish forums. Joscon posts as a level 85 female blood elf mage from the Spanish realm, Dun Modr. A welcome post was made on 08/06/2011 by Katriedna on the World of Warcraft forums.
The Journal of High Marshal Twinbraid can be found behind High Marshal Twinbraid in his room in the secondary keep of Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

Juliette is a goblin found on the Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles. She is being chased by Raphael. She was the pilot of Queen Mae during the Annual Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge Boat Race.
Jubeka's Journal is provided as an objective for Seeking the Soulstones.

Ju Applebloom is a pandaren located in Paw'don Village in the Jade Forest.

Josh RZ is a Blizzard Entertainment employee, and Community Manager and Community Team Lead for Heroes of the Storm.
